link.note: Named as Carmine Fiorillo's mother ('the late Vittoria Marrelli/Morelli') in his 1860 death act (image read).

summary: John's maternal 5th great-grandmother; mother of Carmine Fiorillo. Replaces the tree's 'Maria Morrello'.
bio: Round 3 found her in Carmine's death act (San Mango Morti 1860 act 30); reading Marrelli/Morelli. The tree instead gives Carmine's mother as 'Maria Morrello' (1786-1846) with a deep Morrello/Guercio/Chiarello pedigree - same surname family possibly, different given name. Whether Vittoria and the tree's Maria are the same woman is unresolved.
sources: Antenati, San Mango d'Aquino, Morti 1860, act 30: https://antenati.cultura.gov.it/ark:/12657/an_ua37932559/wWyrDq2
openQuestions: Her parents and origin; Carmine's marriage act
